note: The prayer refrain «бо милість його вічна» (Psalm 136, Kulish numbering = Hebrew) is pasted verbatim from Kulish; 136:4 is the first verse carrying exactly that wording.
Antony's «окаянний я чоловік» echoes Romans 7:24 inside his own words, so it is self_rendered.
The Festal Letter quotation echoes Deuteronomy 4:2 and Revelation 22:18-19 but is Athanasius's own wording, translated, not recorded as scripture.
